scope: Read-only independent recomputation; no evaluator/filter imports, source edits or simulation. Only this JSON and TEST_REPORT.md written.

independent_method.truth: camera.world/forward/right from native renderTruth; horizontally normalized axes; true robot radius=hypot(object.x-vehicle.x,object.z-vehicle.z)*12.5 cm
independent_method.match: object not held; same color; camera forward>0; wrapped bearing error<=3 deg and abs(M5 radial distance - true radial distance)<=30cm
independent_method.label: two or more same-color matches ambiguity; exactly one true; zero false. Mechanically include raw100.
independent_method.candidate: red confidence<0.84 or blue confidence<0.80; independently compared to frozen decisions
independent_method.percent_units: Rates are fractions in JSON and percentages in Markdown.

policy.grouping: current-round trajectories determine the current denominator; v28r1 groups are a separate conservative comparison
policy.start: observe immediately preceding first nonempty WM frame; otherwise first red detection
policy.end: before delivery_phase_start; delivery outcomes remain separately reported
policy.normalization: remove absolute ticks, map/package/track IDs, blue detections, pre-confirmation patrol; robot/WM positions relative to first retained observation
policy.comparison: same target-event order and categorical fields; complete-link groups (every member pair must match)
policy.success: all group members confirmed AND grabbed the WM-associated real target; mixed outcomes fail
policy.stationary_repeat: consecutive actual observe calls at the same tick, or pose displacement <5cm AND heading change <10deg; prefer exact logged odometry, fallback to driver truth samples
policy.blocked_motion_guard: observe_motion_violation is a failed attempted observation; it fails its run and the guard gate even though the actual observe was prevented
policy.fixed_rule_gates: no run may fail a fixed rule; every confirmed-and-grabbed run must pass every fixed rule; unreached-phase unknowns on unsuccessful runs remain unknown
policy.truth_association: WM-to-truth distance <=30cm; no raw-detection or nearest-only fallback labels

duplicate_group_caveat: S01 map01/map03 is one independent target-trajectory scenario; frozen normalization discards blue detections and preconfirmation patrol. Full-run detection data is pooled with member rows separately, not claimed independent and not silently deduplicated.

native_png_totals.budget_policy: 20 MiB per run, not pooled over 10 runs
